rachael: Heads-up: Support ticket — Org Q observed a 500 on /v1/complete but they had actually tripped a route tenant quota. They expect a 429 and clearer guidance.
vik: Can you paste the raw response + headers? :eyes: 
rachael: ```http
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
X-Route-Id: rt-777
X-Decision: admission_late
X-Trace: t-444a

{ \"error\": \"shard_timeout\" }
```
imran: This is the late-enforcement pattern again. We need a prescriptive precedence table: if any component labels an outcome as a client_effect (quota, rate_limit, auth), that should win over opaque 5xx for client-facing semantics. If multiple client_effects appear, choose the most specific origin (route > tenant > org).
ash: Proposal: introduce stable headers: `X-Client-Outcome` (string), `X-Client-Outcome-Code` (numeric/subcode like `429.1.1`), `X-Outcome-Origin` (ingress|route|model), and `X-Outcome-Proto` (v1). Gateway will consult a small rulebook: if final outcome origin != none and outcome is client_effect, rewrite outward HTTP status to the canonical client code when possible and attach headers. For streaming we cannot rewrite status mid-flight — instead emit a final sentinel JSON line:
```json
{ \"sentinel\": true, \"outcome\": \"quota\", \"code\": \"429.1.1\", \"msg\": \"quota exceeded\" }
```
and then close the stream. We'll publish this as part of API v1.1 so integrators can opt in prior to any deprecation.
support-bot: Impact: customer treated 5xx as server-retry and retried aggressively, increasing load. Classifying as "high" for immediate fix.
rachael: Actionables: 1) add contract tests to the integration harness that simulate late quota and assert that gateway advertises 429 + headers for non-stream flows, and that streaming flows receive the final sentinel; 2) add an e2e that runs on gateway PRs to catch regressions.
vik: Telemetry: emit `client_outcome_total` with labels `outcome`, `origin`, `route`, `outcome_code`. Dashboard: add a "Contract mismatches" tile showing percent of 5xx where `outcome!=infra`. Also add a per-route time series of `outcome_code` to spot shifting patterns.
imran: Console UX: route details needs an "Error contract" quick-help that explains precedence and shows the top outcome_codes for the route. Add a contextual CTA "Request quota increase" pre-filled with route + peak usage. Copy: "This route is impacted by tenant quota. Request more capacity or view usage." Keep it short.
ash: Rollout plan: feature-flag `gateway_rules_v1`. Canary 2% for 12h -> 20% for 48h -> 100% if stable. Watchers: 1) expected increase in 429 telemetry, 2) no net rise in infra 5xx, 3) stream sentinel events causing client breakage. Pager if stream sentinel events > 0.7% of affected traffic. Also publish changelog + SDK note for the new headers and sentinel format.
rachael: Ownership: @ash implements gateway mapping + rulebook + integration tests, @vik builds telemetry + dashboard tiles, @imran drafts console copy + CTA, @rachael drafts the customer-facing support note and PR spec.
vik: naming nit: prefer `X-Client-Outcome` over `X-Client-Status` to avoid collisions with existing fields. Lock the names in the spec and add them to the public changelog to avoid mid-rollout renames.
imran: Also add a quick linter in the gateway CI that detects missing `client_outcome` fields on proxied responses — catches regressions where a route forgets to annotate.
rachael: Good call. I'll add that to the test checklist. Schedule a 30-min post-canary review to verify dashboard signals and customer impact metrics.
ash: I'll open the initial PR and link tests; please comment on the rule precedence table.
